description: Enhanced producer-send coverage: three single-topic messages create three independent root traces; a single message whose client response echoes more records than messages (with some optional record fields absent) renders every returned record field-filtered; and a publish of an empty message list emits no spans and no inject lines.

cases.expected_output:
produce topic=orders status=ok result_records=0
inject msg=0 carries=span#0
inject msg=1 carries=span#1
inject msg=2 carries=span#2
spans=3
span 0 kind=producer name=orders trace=t0 parent=root status=unset
  messaging.system=kafka
  messaging.destination=orders
  messaging.destination_kind=topic
span 1 kind=producer name=orders trace=t1 parent=root status=unset
  messaging.system=kafka
  messaging.destination=orders
  messaging.destination_kind=topic
span 2 kind=producer name=orders trace=t2 parent=root status=unset
  messaging.system=kafka
  messaging.destination=orders
  messaging.destination_kind=topic

produce topic=orders status=ok result_records=3
  record 0 topicName=orders partition=0 offset=100
  record 1 topicName=orders offset=101
  record 2 topicName=orders partition=2
inject msg=0 carries=span#0
spans=1
span 0 kind=producer name=orders trace=t0 parent=root status=unset
  messaging.system=kafka
  messaging.destination=orders
  messaging.destination_kind=topic
